Read out of saint.gr's line for 5 Ιουνίου, «Αγιος Λεωνιδης Μαρτυρας Εν Αιγυπτω», with the rank word left off. The day's line names the ten together and the life page heads each of them separately.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 5 июня ст. ст. — «Мчч. Маркиана , Никандра , Иперехия , Аполлона , Леонида , Ария , Горгия , Селиния , Ириния и Памвона (ок. 305-311).»

attestations.note: The day's second entry of twelve, «Мчч. Маркиана , Никандра , Иперехия , Аполлона , Леонида , Ария , Горгия , Селиния , Ириния и Памвона (ок. 305-311).», one line naming TEN people and giving them one bracket; ten `name:` links stand under it, one for each, and all ten already had folders in this corpus, every one of them kept on this same menologion day by the Romanian or the Greek calendar or both. Nine of the ten name links point at one life, `life1237`, which was NOT read; the tenth, Леонид, points at an index of its own, `id1340`, which was not followed either. The identification rests on the day, on the ten names in the calendar's own order, on the year, and on the Egypt nine of the ten name pages give each of them. The year the line gives the company, «(ок. 305-311)», is the reading each folder was to be measured against one at a time; where a folder already held a date it was left alone and the line's interval is recorded here. The day page prints eleven hymns, for two Solovki abbots, a bishop of Tyre, a prince of Chernigov, a metropolitan of Kyiv and a prince of Novgorod, and NONE under any of these ten names. azbyka.ru was not read. **He is the one of the ten whose name page is different from the other nine**: 1340 is headed «Мученик Леонид», with the rank spelled out and NO Egypt and no epithet of any kind after it, and his life link is an index, `id1340`, where the other nine share `life1237`. He is upgraded here on the line's own ordering — fifth of the ten, between Аполлон and Арий — and on the folder's standing on this menologion day, and NOT on his name page, which has nothing in it that could be compared with anything. **NO `ru` NAME FORM WAS STORED FOR HIM, against BRIEF-RUSSIAN §2, and this is deliberate**: the calendar’s only name for him is the bare «Леонид», and storing it would widen the pre-existing UNREAD fold ‘леонид’ from three holders to four — `leonid-presbyter-martyr-1937`, `leonides-father-of-origen`, `leonides-of-epidaurus` — which neither the plain gate nor `corpus-gate --batch` fails on when an upgrade does it, and reading three other Leonid dossiers was not this day’s work. The fold’s exact membership is handed to the author. The other nine of the ten all took their forms, every one with the Egypt its name page gives.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 5 iunie — «Sfinţii Mucenici Marchian, Nicandru, Iperehie, Apolon, Leonid, Arie, Gheorghe, Selneniad, Irineu şi Pamvon»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 5ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιοι Δέκα Μάρτυρες εν Αιγύπτω»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day as the folder's Romanian row, and carries the whole company on one page under the day's line «Άγιοι Δέκα Μάρτυρες εν Αιγύπτω», with a head line for each of the ten: Μαρκιανός, Νίκανδρος, Απόλλων, Λεωνίδης, Γοργίας, Ειρήνη, Σελληνιάδα, Άρειος, Υπερέχιος, Παμβών. The account matches the folder's: they were denounced to the idolatrous eparch of Alexandria, confessed boldly, and were condemned to die of hunger and thirst, left naked days on end in the cold of winter while the soldiers ate and drank in front of them, and died unshaken. The Greek says in so many words that the company held women — the eparch hoped to frighten «τουλάχιστον τις γυναίκες» into sacrificing, and «άνδρες και γυναίκες, πέθαναν απαρασάλευτοι» — and it puts the feminine article on three of the ten names. The corpus reads all ten as men, after doxologia; that disagreement is recorded here and nothing is changed on it. No hymn is printed.
